entry.text: TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn models.
◦ Developed APIs for seamless integration into MLOps pipelines (on-prem & cloud), supporting secure and compliant AI
lifecycle workflows.
• LLM-Govern: AI Compliance Assistant                                                                                                   (Mercedes Benz R& D India Project)
◦ Responsible AI | GDPR | RAG | LLAMA | LangChain
◦ Engineered a compliance assistant for GDPR-aligned AI model evaluations using a fine-tuned LLAMA model with RAG.
◦ Built a web-based tool where developers input model/dataset metadata to receive compliance summaries and actionable
guidance via Responsible AI tool links.
• LexiQ-RAG: Legal Intelligence Assistant                                                                      (Mercedes Benz R& D India Project)
◦ LLM | RAG | LangChain | LLAMA 3 | Prompt Engineering
◦ Built an Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system using LLAMA 3 to streamline legal policy search across
internal documents.
◦ Designed conversational workflows with Chain-of-Thought prompting for interpretable reasoning.
◦ Integrated human-in-the-loop validation with legal experts and fine-tuned the model using proprietary legal corpora,
significantly reducing manual legal consultations.
• CompliCheck-RAG: Functional Compliance & Defeat Detectiont                                                 (Mercedes Benz R& D India Project)
◦ RAG | GPT-4 | LangChain | PDF Parsing | JSON Structuring | Simulink Analysis
◦ Developed an intelligent assistant to analyze ECU configurations from MATLAB -generated PDFs by converting diagrams
into structured JSON.
◦ Automated detection of defeat device behavior by mapping functional requirements to ECU parameters, delivering
detailed compliance reports.
◦ Enabled engineers to query functional flows, improving defect detection and regulatory alignment.
• Real-Time Malware Detection at EV Charging Stations                                                                     (Mercedes Benz R& D India Project)
◦ Azure Databricks | PySpark | Power BI | Kafka | MLlib | Spark Streaming
◦ Built a real-time malware anomaly detection pipeline using sensor data collected during EV charging.
◦ Processed streaming data using PySpark, stored results in Azure Data Lake, and visualized insights via Power BI
dashboards.
◦ Implemented ML models to detect and alert on malicious socket behavior, enhancing EV cybersecurity.
• Secure Federated Learning Architecture                                                                                                                                    (MTech Thesis)
◦ Federated Learning | TensorFlow | Docker | Socket Programming | Privacy -Preserving AI
◦ Proposed a privacy-preserved Federated Learning architecture to defend against poisoning and inference attacks.
◦ Implemented secure communication protocols and differential privacy techniques for decentralized model training
across edge nodes.
